DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';

-- 1. Drop Constraints
SELECT @sql += N'ALTER TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(parent_object_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id)) +
                N' DROP CONSTRAINT ' + QUOTENAME(name) + ';'
FROM sys.objects 
WHERE type in ('F', 'UQ', 'D') AND is_ms_shipped = 0; --AND QUOTENAME(OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(parent_object_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(OBJECT_NAME(parent_object_id)) = '[pfw].[DatiModuloCommessa]';

-- 2. Drop Stored Procedures
SELECT @sql += N'DROP PROCEDURE ' + QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) + ';'
 FROM sys.objects
 WHERE type = 'P'
 AND is_ms_shipped = 0; --AND QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) = '[dbo].[spDeleteTestNotebook]';

-- 3. Drop Views
SELECT @sql += N'DROP VIEW ' + QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) + ';'
 FROM sys.objects
 WHERE type = 'V'
 AND is_ms_shipped = 0; -- AND QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) = '[pfd].[NotificheNoRec]';

--4. Drop tables
SELECT @sql += N'DROP TABLE ' + QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) + ';'
 FROM sys.tables
 WHERE is_ms_shipped = 0;-- AND QUOTENAME(SCHEMA_NAME(schema_id)) + '.' + QUOTENAME(name) = '[pfw].[DatiModuloCommessa]';

select @sql as DropCommand

SELECT
    'CREATE TABLE [' + SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '].[' + t.name + '] (' +
    STUFF((
        SELECT
            ', [' + c.name + '] ' +
            TYPE_NAME(c.system_type_id) +
            CASE
                WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.system_type_id) IN ('varchar', 'nvarchar', 'varbinary') THEN '(' + IIF(c.max_length = -1, 'MAX', CAST(c.max_length AS VARCHAR(10))) + ')'
                WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.system_type_id) IN ('char', 'nchar', 'binary') THEN '(' + CAST(c.max_length AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.system_type_id) IN ('decimal', 'numeric') THEN '(' + CAST(c.precision AS VARCHAR(10)) + ',' + CAST(c.scale AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                WHEN TYPE_NAME(c.system_type_id) IN ('datetime2', 'datetimeoffset', 'time') THEN '(' + CAST(c.scale AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')'
                ELSE ''
            END +
            CASE WHEN c.is_identity = 1 THEN ' IDENTITY(' + CAST(ISNULL(ic.seed_value,1) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ',' + CAST(ISNULL(ic.increment_value,1) AS VARCHAR(10)) + ')' ELSE '' END +
            ' ' +
            CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN 'NULL' ELSE 'NOT NULL' END --+
            --CASE WHEN dc.definition IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT ' + dc.definition ELSE '' END
        FROM sys.columns c
        LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON c.default_object_id = dc.object_id
        LEFT JOIN sys.identity_columns ic ON c.object_id = ic.object_id AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
        WHERE c.object_id = t.object_id
        ORDER BY c.column_id
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') +
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.key_constraints kc WHERE kc.parent_object_id = t.object_id AND kc.type = 'PK')
         THEN ', CONSTRAINT [' + (SELECT name FROM sys.key_constraints WHERE parent_object_id = t.object_id AND type = 'PK') + '] PRIMARY KEY (' +
              STUFF((SELECT ', [' + COL_NAME(ic.object_id, ic.column_id) + ']'
                     FROM sys.index_columns ic
                     INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
                     WHERE ic.object_id = t.object_id AND i.is_primary_key = 1
                     ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal
                     FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') + ')'
         ELSE ''
    END +
    ');' AS create_query,
	SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '.' + t.name as tablename
FROM sys.tables t
WHERE t.is_ms_shipped = 0 AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) != 'dbo' AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '.' + t.name in ('pfd.relupload','pfd.ContestazioniStorico')
ORDER BY SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id), t.name;

DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(MAX) = N'';

SELECT
    @sql += N'ALTER TABLE [' + SCHEMA_NAME(fk.schema_id) + '].[' + OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) + '] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [' + fk.name + '] FOREIGN KEY (' +
    STUFF((
        SELECT ', [' + COL_NAME(fcs.parent_object_id, fcs.parent_column_id) + ']'
        FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fcs
        WHERE fcs.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
        ORDER BY fcs.constraint_column_id
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') +
    ') REFERENCES [' + SCHEMA_NAME(rob.schema_id) + '].[' + OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) + '] (' +
    STUFF((
        SELECT ', [' + COL_NAME(fcs.referenced_object_id, fcs.referenced_column_id) + ']'
        FROM sys.foreign_key_columns fcs
        WHERE fcs.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
        ORDER BY fcs.constraint_column_id
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') +
    ')' +
    CASE WHEN fk.delete_referential_action = 1 THEN ' ON DELETE CASCADE'
         WHEN fk.delete_referential_action = 2 THEN ' ON DELETE SET NULL'
         WHEN fk.delete_referential_action = 3 THEN ' ON DELETE SET DEFAULT'
         ELSE ''
    END +
    CASE WHEN fk.update_referential_action = 1 THEN ' ON UPDATE CASCADE'
         WHEN fk.update_referential_action = 2 THEN ' ON UPDATE SET NULL'
         WHEN fk.update_referential_action = 3 THEN ' ON UPDATE SET DEFAULT'
         ELSE ''
    END +
    ';' + 'ALTER TABLE [' + SCHEMA_NAME(fk.schema_id) + '].' + QUOTENAME(OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id)) + ' CHECK CONSTRAINT [' + fk.name + '];'
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
INNER JOIN sys.objects AS rob ON fk.referenced_object_id = rob.object_id
WHERE fk.is_ms_shipped = 0 -- Escludi le chiavi esterne di sistema

--AND SCHEMA_NAME(fk.schema_id) + '.' + OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) = 'pfw.DatiModuloCommessa'
--AND '[' + SCHEMA_NAME(fk.schema_id) + '].[' + OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) + ']' not in ('[pfw].[Prodotti]', '[pfw].[Stato]')

SELECT
    @sql += N'ALTER TABLE [' + SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '].[' + t.name + '] ADD CONSTRAINT [' + kc.name + '] UNIQUE (' +
    STUFF((
        SELECT ', [' + COL_NAME(ic.object_id, ic.column_id) + ']'
        FROM sys.index_columns ic
        INNER JOIN sys.indexes i ON ic.object_id = i.object_id AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
        WHERE ic.object_id = kc.parent_object_id AND i.is_unique_constraint = 1 AND i.index_id = kc.unique_index_id
        ORDER BY ic.key_ordinal
        FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE
    ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 1, '') +
    ');'
FROM sys.key_constraints kc
INNER JOIN sys.tables t ON kc.parent_object_id = t.object_id
WHERE kc.type = 'UQ' -- 'UQ' sta per UNIQUE constraint
  AND kc.is_ms_shipped = 0 -- Escludi i vincoli di sistema
  --AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '.' + t.name = 'pfw.DatiModuloCommessa'

SELECT
@sql += N'ALTER TABLE [' + SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '].['+ t.name + '] ADD CONSTRAINT ['+ dc.name
+ '] DEFAULT ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(dc.definition, '(',''), ')','') + ' FOR [' + c.name  + '];'
from sys.default_constraints dc
inner join sys.all_columns c on c.default_object_id = dc.object_id
inner join sys.tables t on c.object_id = t.object_id
--where SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '.' + t.name = 'pfw.DatiModuloCommessa'

SELECT @sql as create_query

SELECT
	SCHEMA_NAME(v.schema_id)+'.'+v.name as name
FROM sys.views v
INNER JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON v.object_id = sm.object_id
WHERE v.is_ms_shipped = 0 --AND SCHEMA_NAME(v.schema_id) + '.'+ v.name = 'pfd.NotificheNoRec'
UNION ALL
SELECT
	SCHEMA_NAME(p.schema_id)+'.'+p.name as name
	FROM sys.procedures p
INNER JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON p.object_id = sm.object_id
WHERE p.is_ms_shipped = 0 --AND SCHEMA_NAME(p.schema_id) +'.'+ p.name = 'dbo.spDeleteTestNotebook'

SELECT ' CREATE ' +
       CASE 
            WHEN I.is_unique = 1 THEN ' UNIQUE '
            ELSE ''
       END +
       I.type_desc COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT + ' INDEX ' +
       I.name + ' ON ' +
       SCHEMA_NAME(T.schema_id) + '.' + T.name + ' ( ' +
       KeyColumns + ' )  ' +
       ISNULL(' INCLUDE (' + IncludedColumns + ' ) ', '') +
       ISNULL(' WHERE  ' + I.filter_definition, '') + ' WITH ( ' +
       CASE 
            WHEN I.is_padded = 1 THEN ' PAD_INDEX = ON '
            ELSE ' PAD_INDEX = OFF '
       END + ',' +
       'FILLFACTOR = ' + CONVERT(
           CHAR(5),
           CASE 
                WHEN I.fill_factor = 0 THEN 100
                ELSE I.fill_factor
           END
       ) + ',' +
       -- default value 
       'SORT_IN_TEMPDB = OFF ' + ',' +
       CASE 
            WHEN I.ignore_dup_key = 1 THEN ' IGNORE_DUP_KEY = ON '
            ELSE ' IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF '
       END + ',' +
       CASE 
            WHEN ST.no_recompute = 0 THEN ' STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF '
            ELSE ' STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = ON '
       END + ',' +
       ' ONLINE = OFF ' + ',' +
       CASE 
            WHEN I.allow_row_locks = 1 THEN ' ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON '
            ELSE ' ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = OFF '
       END + ',' +
       CASE 
            WHEN I.allow_page_locks = 1 THEN ' ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON '
            ELSE ' ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = OFF '
       END + ' ) ON [' +
       DS.name + ' ] ' +  CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) [CreateIndexScript]
FROM   sys.indexes I
       JOIN sys.tables T
            ON  T.object_id = I.object_id
       JOIN sys.sysindexes SI
            ON  I.object_id = SI.id
            AND I.index_id = SI.indid
       JOIN (
                SELECT *
                FROM   (
                           SELECT IC2.object_id,
                                  IC2.index_id,
                                  STUFF(
                                      (
                                          SELECT ' , ' + C.name + CASE 
                                                                       WHEN MAX(CONVERT(INT, IC1.is_descending_key)) 
                                                                            = 1 THEN 
                                                                            ' DESC '
                                                                       ELSE 
                                                                            ' ASC '
                                                                  END
                                          FROM   sys.index_columns IC1
                                                 JOIN sys.columns C
                                                      ON  C.object_id = IC1.object_id
                                                      AND C.column_id = IC1.column_id
                                                      AND IC1.is_included_column = 
                                                          0
                                          WHERE  IC1.object_id = IC2.object_id
                                                 AND IC1.index_id = IC2.index_id
                                          GROUP BY
                                                 IC1.object_id,
                                                 C.name,
                                                 index_id
                                          ORDER BY
                                                 MAX(IC1.key_ordinal) 
                                                 FOR XML PATH('')
                                      ),
                                      1,
                                      2,
                                      ''
                                  ) KeyColumns
                           FROM   sys.index_columns IC2 
                                  --WHERE IC2.Object_id = object_id('Person.Address') --Comment for all tables
                           GROUP BY
                                  IC2.object_id,
                                  IC2.index_id
                       ) tmp3
            )tmp4
            ON  I.object_id = tmp4.object_id
            AND I.Index_id = tmp4.index_id
       JOIN sys.stats ST
            ON  ST.object_id = I.object_id
            AND ST.stats_id = I.index_id
       JOIN sys.data_spaces DS
            ON  I.data_space_id = DS.data_space_id
       JOIN sys.filegroups FG
            ON  I.data_space_id = FG.data_space_id
       LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT *
                FROM   (
                           SELECT IC2.object_id,
                                  IC2.index_id,
                                  STUFF(
                                      (
                                          SELECT ' , ' + C.name
                                          FROM   sys.index_columns IC1
                                                 JOIN sys.columns C
                                                      ON  C.object_id = IC1.object_id
                                                      AND C.column_id = IC1.column_id
                                                      AND IC1.is_included_column = 
                                                          1
                                          WHERE  IC1.object_id = IC2.object_id
                                                 AND IC1.index_id = IC2.index_id
                                          GROUP BY
                                                 IC1.object_id,
                                                 C.name,
                                                 index_id 
                                                 FOR XML PATH('')
                                      ),
                                      1,
                                      2,
                                      ''
                                  ) IncludedColumns
                           FROM   sys.index_columns IC2 
                                  --WHERE IC2.Object_id = object_id('Person.Address') --Comment for all tables
                           GROUP BY
                                  IC2.object_id,
                                  IC2.index_id
                       ) tmp1
                WHERE  IncludedColumns IS NOT NULL
            ) tmp2
            ON  tmp2.object_id = I.object_id
            AND tmp2.index_id = I.index_id
WHERE  I.is_primary_key = 0
       AND I.is_unique_constraint = 0
